items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I knew him, met him, but I never played with him.

ctx.x: Yeah. Of course, it's been changed since then. And there's a lot of things that -- in Europe they had me on things with Jelly Roll Morton but I didn't ever play with Jelly Roll. I knew him, met him, but I never played with him.
Well, what was it, the Rhythm Club?
